channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: NRHEG's Vanmaldeghem proves too much for Viking girls
item.description: Vanmaldeghem scores 39 and surpasses 2,000 career points as No. 3 NRHEG edges Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy 56-53; Christopherson leads Vikings with 21 in comeback bid.

item.title: Southland girls overpower Kenyon-Wanamingo
item.description: Grace Kresbach scores 18 as Southland (18-3) overpowers Kenyon-Wanamingo (8-15) 62-28 in Kenyon in girls basketball.

item.title: Bruins top Norsemen, will host Paint the Rink Pink game Saturday night
item.description: Cody Butikis’ 16 saves and Siamion Marshchanok’s 23rd goal lifted the Austin Bruins over St. Cloud 3-1; they meet again Saturday for Paint the Rink Pink at Riverside Arena.

item.title: A view of Wescott
item.description: Work begins on the former Mayo west building to convert the structure into northwest Austin apartment complex

item.title: Nearly perfect in pink: Bruins grab their eighth straight win, stay in first place
item.description: Siamion Marschanok’s hat trick powers Austin Bruins to a 6-2 Paint the Rink Pink win over St. Cloud, their eighth straight victory to stay atop the NAHL Central.

item.title: Rebel boys win 14th straight game
item.description: Southland boys secure 14th straight win as Tate Goergen scores 34 in 95-57 victory over Schaeffer Academy, moving the Rebels to 19-1 overall.

item.title: Blue Devil women brought down by Minnesota West
item.description: Riverland women's basketball falls 128-26 to Minnesota West, drops to 0-17; Alexis Jones leads Blue Devils with 10 points.

item.title: No. 2 Blue Devil men take down Minnesota West
item.description: No. 2 Riverland men roll past Minnesota West 92-68 behind Tristan Coleman's 25 points and 11 rebounds, improving to 24-1 overall in Saturday's home win.

item.title: Dodge County ends season for Packer girls
item.description: Austin girls hockey season ends with 15-0 Section 1A semifinal loss to top-seeded Dodge County; Packers finish 10-15-2 overall.

item.title: APDT headed back to state meet
item.description: Austin Packer dance team returns to state after Section 1AA meet, taking first in kick and second in jazz to qualify in both events.
